ext.notes: Copy to <secrets_dir>/asr-server.json (owner mcap-asr, not writable by others). Every key shown has its default; delete what you do not change. A non-loopback listen address needs tls_cert and tls_key (a loopback bind behind a TLS terminator may stay plaintext). tls_key must be 0600 and owned by mcap-asr. backend is an engine id of asr_engines.REGISTRY: whisper (local MLX model, the default) or, only after the owner approves it, a relay backend such as azure. model empty = mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-mlx (the model is never downloaded by the server: put it in the Hugging Face cache of the service user first). Keys must stay in this file's set: an unknown key refuses to start.
